Anchors: move 173B/13bb identical at slot 6; sync thunk at slot 8; slot 3/4/5 createProperty/getDTI/setup. Applies unchanged to every uCameraBossEm* subclass (their overrides are 0,3,4,5,6,8); empty move overrides fold into nullsub_2 0x507330.

notes: All three classes present in DX9. Main vtable labels were already correct (verified by ctor vtable stores); MyDTI vtables were unlabelled and are now labelled Class::MyDTI::vftable (0xBC5FE8, 0xBC61B4, 0xBC62C8; slot 0 = shared MtDTI dtor sub_410360, slot 1 = newInstance). DX9 TU order: getDTI, createProperty, MyDTI::newInstance, ctor, (dtor), setup, move/sync, helpers - different from SE but contiguous per class. Structural fixes: defined newInstance stubs 0x4C3450 / 0x4CB9F0 and Dante scalar deleting dtor 0x4CBE60 (were loc_); split 0x4CD910 (old name uCameraBossEm018::uCameraBossEm018) into MyDTI::newInstance 0x4CD910-0x4CD930 and ctor 0x4CD930. ICF folds: 0x4CDCE0 = vector deleting dtor of BOTH uCameraBoss and uCameraBossEm018 (raw vtable slot 0 of 0xBC5FAC and 0xBC628C both point to it; body lies in the Em018 region, so named ??_EuCameraBossEm018@@UAEPAXI@Z, comment lists both); 0x4C7A10 = uCameraBoss::checkAngleYinFan, ICF-identical to cCameraPlayer::checkAngleYinFan (group A, SE 0x54C5D0; DX9 callers cCameraPlayer::main00 / cameraAngleYHosei); uCameraBoss::sync = jmp uDevilCamera::sync -> DX9 slot 8 is the shared thunk j_uDevilCamera::sync 0x749630 (commented, not renamed); empty Dante/Em018 move -> nullsub_2 0x507330. Wrong old names replaced: uDevilCamera::resolveMovement -> uCameraBoss::checkHit; uDevilCamera::move_tick -> uCameraBossDante::commonProccess; uDevilCamera::move_tick_mode0 -> uCameraBossEm018::commonProccess; uCameraBossDante::move -> ::sync (slot 8); uCameraBossDante::init -> ::setup. Inlined in DX9 (no body): ~uCameraBoss, ~uCameraBossEm018, checkHitBoss, getPlBasePos, upDate, actionMessage, getActionMessage, lowLimit, resetCamera, checkInCameraFanSector. Dead in SE (no callers) and absent in DX9: checkHitCircumference, emOffsetCamPosSet, emOffsetPosSet, setOffsetCamPos, rotateVectorXY, rotateVectorY, calcNormalPlCam, checkHitNormalPlCam, moveRightStickAxisX, moveRightStickAxisY2, Dante/Em018 die, Em018 groundThrow03/groundThrow02Ex/airThrow03/airThrow02Ex. Coordinator leads: D/E lists agree with this mapping except (1) D "0x4C5750 lowLimit" is wrong - 0x4C5750 is correctPlOver (8474 B, setLookAtRH/setPerspectiveFovRH); lowLimit is inlined; (2) E "0x4C52B0 = oldPosTarPreservation" is wrong - decompile shows basePosSet; oldPosTarPreservation is 0x4C7B10. setFovAssign 0x4C8D90 upgraded to high on D/E agreement. No DX9-only functions remain unassigned in the three class regions.
